passages.text: # ChatGPT Prompt for Privacy & Security Data Cleanup
Focused on permissions, tracking, discoverability, and data that keeps leaking without your permission.
That causes apps requesting tracking permission to be treated as though you chose “Ask App Not to Track.” (Apple Support)
For a privacy-first setup, I would either **turn unnecessary history off** or use the shortest auto-delete period you’re comfortable with.
Remove anything you no longer use. Revoking access stops future access, although it does **not necessarily delete data the third-party app previously copied**. (Google Help)
You can disable personalized advertising or restrict which account/activity signals are used. (Google Help)
Google can look for Search results containing your **phone number, home address or email**, alert you, and let you request removal of eligible results. (Google Help)
## 3. Lock Down Your Social Media Accounts
Turn off **Sync address book contacts**, and use **Remove all contacts** if you’ve previously uploaded them. Simply stopping sync does not remove previously uploaded contacts.
For Facebook, Meta specifically recommends its **Privacy Checkup** to review what you’re publicly sharing. (facebook.com)

If a result exposes personal contact information, send it through **Results about you**. Google permits removal requests for things including home addresses, phone numbers, emails, certain government IDs and financial information. (Google Help)
***IMPORTANT:** I will NEVER ask you for money. I am NOT sending you friend requests. I am NOT on Whatsapp, Telegram, or messaging apps. I will NEVER sell a course. Always block & report scammers.*
